pairs.evidence: clients/typescript/test/fixtures/feed-shared-stamp.json:8 The SDK's one store-emitted fixture is re-baselined by a runtime env var that the golden writer obeys silently (write and return, no pipeline refusal, no test asserting the switch is off), so a runner or shell with PUMPER_UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 exported turns the golden compare into a rewrite that reports green; the stale 'hand-written field list' deviation is fixed: required fields are now read from the served OpenAPI schema.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/tests/change_feed_keyset.rs:123 Record switch for clients/typescript/test/fixtures/feed-shared-stamp.json is an environment flag with no CI refusal and no integrity test; the technique names exactly this shape as invisible.

clients/typescript/test/conformance.test.ts:80 Hand-authored record/revision fixtures are held to clients/openapi.json (generated from the router), so a field added server-side fails the fixture instead of letting it validate yesterday's shape.

clients/typescript/test/conformance.test.ts:167 The decision is asserted at the crossing (the URL handed to fetch), not at an in-process derivation; the keyset fake also serves pages by cursor rather than by call counter.

clients/typescript/test/conformance.test.ts:480 The replayed feed is captured from a real Datasets store and kept fresh by a golden compare on the Rust side (its re-record guard is the deviation above).

pairs.evidence: plugins-src/trigger-gate/src/lib.rs:160 trigger-gate's tests decide pass/veto against envelopes hand-copied from triggers.rs (dataset_trigger_obj/terminal_trigger_obj/external_trigger_obj), and nothing checks the copies against their producers; the shipped-plugin e2e test also uses a hand-written dataset delta, so only the job-hop envelope runs through the real fire path, and a renamed dataset-envelope field would leave every plugin test green while the gate misjudges in production.
